newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to pay $85 mln overdue foreign debts.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to pay $85 mln overdue foreign debts.

text.p: The Venezuelan government plans to pay $85 million in overdue principal and interest payments on foreign debt that came due in 1994 and 1995, according to Finance Ministry documents submitted to Congress on Thursday.
The payments form part of a request to spend 200.277 billion bolivars ($431 million) in revenues raised from a recent issue of 650 million marks worth of Eurobonds.
"The Finance Ministry asks for 200.277 billion bolivars to meet outstanding payments of domestic and foreign debt which expired in 1994 and 1995," the document says.
Of the $85 million set aside for foreign debt, $76 million is for principal and $9 million for interest payments.

Of the 160.879 billion bolivars set aside for domestic debt, 106.940 billion is principal and 53.939 is interest payments. The payment of the debt arrears "will generate a greater perception of the risk rating in the markets," the Finance Ministry document says.

The Finance Ministry request to spend the 200.277 billion bolivars requires approval from the finance committees of both the Senate and Lower Chamber and a final approval by a joint session of Congress.
